summary: React Query Migration Iteration 141 - Employees.js tested after migration from 13 axios calls to React Query hooks. Found and fixed 2 critical bugs: (1) 'users is not defined' error - changed to 'usersWithRoles', (2) 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading length)' in Org Chart - added null check for orgChart. Employees page now loads correctly with 48 employees, stats cards, CRUD operations, and Org Chart tab.

minor.issue: Returns 404 - endpoint may not exist or is named differently. Non-blocking for Employees page.

issues: Stats show 0 for 'With System Access', 'No System Access', 'Departments' - may need backend API check

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Line 849 - Changed 'users' to 'usersWithRoles' (undefined variable reference)
FIXED: Line 631 - Added null check for 'orgChart' to prevent 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading length)'
useEmployees.js hooks properly structured with useAllEmployees, useEmployeeStats, useDepartmentsList, useOrgChart queries
useEmployees.js mutations working: useUpdateEmployee, useDeleteEmployee, useLinkEmployeeToUser, useGrantEmployeeAccess, useRevokeEmployeeAccess, useUnlinkEmployeeFromUser, useUpdateMobileAccess
New hooks usePricingPlans.js (7 hooks), useSOW.js (10 hooks), useMeetings.js (9 hooks) - properly structured

success_rate.frontend: 100% - Employees page loads correctly after fixes

context_for_next_testing_agent: Employees.js React Query migration complete. Fixed 2 bugs in the migration. Page shows 48 employees with full CRUD operations. Stats cards visible. Directory and Org Chart tabs both working. /api/users-with-roles returns 404 but is non-blocking. New hooks (usePricingPlans, useSOW, useMeetings) created but not tested - they are used on other pages.

bug_1.root_cause: During React Query migration, 'useUsersWithRoles' hook returns data as 'usersWithRoles', but code referenced undefined 'users' variable

bug_2.error: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')
bug_2.root_cause: Org Chart section tried to access orgChart.length when orgChart could be undefined during loading or API failure
